browser: installed Google Chrome, standalone persistent profile
decision: Keep the two-image queue. The candidate improves distinct visible FPS by about 0.40 while adding about 13.69 ms to measured queued-image age and still failing the 60 distinct-image target. One candidate leg passes the internal 59.5-tolerant QA gate, but the other fails and the full comparison is false.
limits: Queue age is only one component of input-to-photon latency. The 115 matching rolling fingerprints and exact native polling gaps are not full machine equivalence. This experimental binary has a prebuilt cache but source metadata different from the retained patch. No other stage, matchup, browser or Vercel environment is certified.
